row_diagnostics =: 3 : 0
    'fitted params' =. y
    n =. f_n fitted
    rank =. f_rank fitted
    degrees =. n-rank
    sigma =. %:(f_rss fitted)%degrees
    leverage_limit =. ((3{params)*rank)%n
    cook_limit =. (5{params)%n
    dffits_limit =. (6{params)*%:rank%n
    rows =. 0$a:
    for_i. i.n do.
        h =. i{f_leverage fitted
        residual =. i{f_weighted_residual fitted
        z =. residual%(sigma*%:1.0-h)
        studentized =. z*%:(degrees-1)%(degrees-z*z)
        cooks =. ((z*z)*h)%(rank*(1.0-h))
        dffits =. studentized*%:h%(1.0-h)
        flags =. ''
        if. h>leverage_limit do.
            flags =. flags,'H'
        end.
        if. (|studentized)>4{params do.
            flags =. flags,'O'
        end.
        if. cooks>cook_limit do.
            flags =. flags,'C'
        end.
        if. (|dffits)>dffits_limit do.
            flags =. flags,'F'
        end.
        if. 0=#flags do.
            flags =. '-'
        end.
        deleted_sigma =. sigma*%:(degrees-z*z)%(degrees-1)
        dfbetas =. i.0
        for_k. i.rank do.
            value =. (((<i,k){f_g fitted)*residual)%(1.0-h)
            value =. value%(deleted_sigma*%:k{f_variance fitted)
            dfbetas =. dfbetas,value
        end.
        rows =. rows,<(<z),(<studentized),(<cooks),(<dffits),(<flags),<dfbetas
    end.
    rows
)
durbin_watson =: 3 : 0
    residuals =. f_weighted_residual y
    numerator =. 0.0
    for_i. 1+i.(#residuals)-1 do.
        difference =. (i{residuals)-(i-1){residuals
        numerator =. numerator+difference*difference
    end.
    numerator%f_rss y
)
breusch_pagan =: 3 : 0
    'fitted tolerance' =. y
    squared =. *:f_weighted_residual fitted
    matrix =. (f_accepted fitted){"1 f_matrix fitted
    auxiliary =. qr_fit (<matrix),(<squared),(<(f_n fitted)$1.0),<tolerance
    mean =. (ordered_sum squared)%f_n fitted
    centered =. squared-mean
    tss =. ordered_sum centered*centered
    statistic =. (f_n fitted)*(1.0-(f_rss auxiliary)%tss)
    degrees =. (f_rank auxiliary)-1
    statistic,degrees,statistic chi_pvalue degrees
)
jarque_bera =: 3 : 0
    n =. f_n y
    residuals =. f_weighted_residual y
    mean =. (ordered_sum residuals)%n
    m2 =. 0.0
    m3 =. 0.0
    m4 =. 0.0
    for_value. residuals-mean do.
        m2 =. m2+value*value
        m3 =. m3+(value*value)*value
        m4 =. m4+((value*value)*value)*value
    end.
    m2 =. m2%n
    m3 =. m3%n
    m4 =. m4%n
    skewness =. m3%(m2*%:m2)
    kurtosis =. m4%(m2*m2)
    statistic =. (n%6.0)*((skewness*skewness)+((kurtosis-3.0)*(kurtosis-3.0))%4.0)
    statistic,(statistic chi_pvalue 2),skewness,kurtosis
)
calculate_diagnostics =: 3 : 0
    'fitted params' =. y
    (<row_diagnostics y),(<durbin_watson fitted),(<breusch_pagan (<fitted),<0{params),<jarque_bera fitted
)

            result,<remaining return.
        end.
        position =. {.positions
        result =. result,<position{.remaining
        remaining =. (position+#x)}.remaining
    end.
)

parse_model =: 4 : 0
    parts =. ' weights='split_on y
    original =. 0{::parts
    weight =. ''
    if. 2=#parts do.
        weight =. 1{::parts
    end.
    halves =. ' ~ 'split_on original
    terms =. 0$a:
    factor_columns =. i.0
    categorical_columns =. i.0
    variables =. i.0
    for_box. ' + 'split_on 1{::halves do.
        expression =. >box
        expanded =. 0$a:
        if. '*'e.expression do.
            factors =. 0$a:
            for_name. '*'split_on expression do.
                factors =. factors,<x parse_factor >name
            end.
            for_size. 1+i.#factors do.
                for_mask. 1+i.(2^#factors)-1 do.
                    chosen =. factors#~2|<.mask%2^i.#factors
                    if. size=#chosen do.
                        expanded =. expanded,<chosen
                    end.
                end.
            end.
        else.
            factors =. 0$a:
            for_name. ':'split_on expression do.
                factors =. factors,<x parse_factor >name
            end.
            expanded =. <factors
        end.
        for_box. expanded do.
            factors =. >box
            item =. make_term factors
            exists =. 0
            for_previous. terms do.
                if. (t_keys item)-:t_keys >previous do.
                    exists =. 1
                    break.
                end.
            end.
            if. exists do.
                continue.
            end.
            terms =. terms,<item
            for_box. factors do.
                factor =. >box
                column =. f_column factor
                if. -.column e.factor_columns do.
                    factor_columns =. factor_columns,column
                    variables =. variables,column
                end.
                if. (f_categorical factor)*.-.column e.categorical_columns do.
                    categorical_columns =. categorical_columns,column
                end.
            end.
        end.
    end.
    response =. 0{::halves
    response_column =. x i.<response
    weight_column =. _1
    if. #weight do.
        weight_column =. x i.<weight
    end.
    variables =. variables,response_column
    if. weight_column>:0 do.
        variables =. variables,weight_column
    end.
    (<original),(<response),(<response_column),(<weight),(<weight_column),(<terms),(<factor_columns),(<categorical_columns),<variables
)

make_design =: 3 : 0

        row =. index{source

            rows =. rows,row
            row_numbers =. row_numbers,index+1
        end.
    end.

        items =. 0$a:
        if. column e.model_categorical_columns model do.
            items =. /:~~.column{"1 rows

        levels =. levels,<items
    end.
    columns =. <(<_1),(<'(Intercept)'),<0$a:
    terms =. model_terms model
    for_term_index. i.#terms do.
        item =. term_index{::terms
        choices =. 0$a:

        for_box. t_factors item do.

            if. f_categorical factor do.
                for_level. }.(f_column factor){::levels do.
                    components =. components,<(<factor),(<(f_name factor),>level),< >level
                end.
            else.
                components =. <(<factor),(<f_name factor),<''
            end.
            choices =. choices,<components
            total =. total*#components
        end.
        for_code. i.total do.
            remaining =. code
            names =. 0$a:
            components =. 0$a:
            for_box. choices do.
                options =. >box
                component =. ((#options)|remaining){::options
                remaining =. <.remaining%#options
                names =. names,<component_name component
                components =. components,<component
            end.
            name =. ''
            for_index. i.#names do.
                if. index do.
                    name =. name,':'
                end.
                name =. name,index{::names
            end.
            columns =. columns,<(<term_index),(<name),<components
        end.
    end.
    matrix =. (0,#columns)$0.0
    response =. i.0
    weights =. i.0
    for_row. rows do.
        matrix =. matrix,columns design_values row
        response =. response,decimal (model_response_column model){::row
        if. (model_weight_column model)>:0 do.
            weight =. decimal (model_weight_column model){::row
        else.
            weight =. 1.0
        end.
        weights =. weights,weight
    end.
    (<model),(<row_numbers),(<rows),(<levels),(<columns),(<matrix),(<response),<weights
)

log_gamma =: 3 : 0
    coefficients =. 76.18009172947146 _86.50532032941677 24.01409824083091 _1.231739572450155 0.001208650973866179 _0.000005395239384953
    t =. y+5.5
    adjustment =. t-(y+0.5)*^.t
    series =. 1.000000000190015
    for_j. i.6 do.
        series =. series+(j{coefficients)%(y+j+1)
    end.
    (-adjustment)+^.(2.5066282746310005*series)%y
)
replace_small =: 3 : 0
    if. (|y)<1e_300 do.
        1e_300
    else.

    end.

beta_fraction =: 3 : 0
    'a b x' =. y
    c =. 1.0
    d =. 1.0%replace_small 1.0-((a+b)*x)%(a+1.0)
    h =. d
    for_m. 1+i.1000 do.
        q =. ((m*(b-m))*x)%((a-1.0)+2*m)*(a+2*m)
        d =. 1.0%replace_small 1.0+q*d
        c =. replace_small 1.0+q%c
        h =. h*(d*c)
        q =. (((-(a+m))*((a+b)+m))*x)%((a+2*m)*((a+1.0)+2*m))
        d =. 1.0%replace_small 1.0+q*d
        c =. replace_small 1.0+q%c
        delta =. d*c
        h =. h*delta
        if. (|delta-1.0)<1e_15 do.
            break.
        end.
    end.
    h
)
incomplete_beta =: 3 : 0
    'x a b' =. y
    if. x<:0 do.
        0.0 return.
    end.
    if. x>:1 do.
        1.0 return.
    end.
    value =. (log_gamma a+b)-log_gamma a
    value =. value-log_gamma b
    value =. value+a*^.x
    value =. value+b*^.1.0-x
    factor =. ^value
    if. x<(a+1.0)%((a+b)+2.0) do.
        (factor*beta_fraction a,b,x)%a
    else.
        1.0-(factor*beta_fraction b,a,1.0-x)%b
    end.
)
upper_gamma =: 3 : 0
    'a x' =. y
    if. x<:0 do.
        1.0 return.
    end.
    factor =. ^(((-x)+(a*^.x))-log_gamma a)
    if. x<a+1.0 do.
        term =. 1.0%a
        e =. a
        series =. term
        for_index. i.1000 do.
            e =. e+1.0
            term =. term*x%e
            series =. series+term
            if. (|term)<(|series)*1e_15 do.
                break.
            end.
        end.
        1.0-series*factor return.
    end.
    beta =. (x+1.0)-a
    c =. 1.0%1e_300
    d =. 1.0%beta
    h =. d
    for_i. 1+i.1000 do.
        q =. (-i)*(i-a)
        beta =. beta+2.0
        d =. 1.0%replace_small (q*d)+beta
        c =. replace_small beta+q%c
        delta =. d*c
        h =. h*delta
        if. (|delta-1.0)<1e_15 do.
            break.
        end.
    end.
    factor*h
)

table_lines =: 3 : 0

        if. index>0 do.

    end.

        fields =. (column{columns),(<integer #values),(<integer (#source)-#values),(<four mean),(<four %:variance%(#values)-1),(<four <./values),<four >./values
        rows =. rows,<fields
    end.
    lines =. (<'Data: ',(integer #source),' rows, ',(integer #columns),' columns'),(<''),<'Numeric columns:'
    lines =. lines,table_plain (<;:'column n missing Mean SD Min Max'),<rows
    lines =. lines,(<''),<'Categorical columns:'
    for_column. I.df_categorical data do.
        cells =. column{"1 source
        present =. cells#~cells~:< 'NA'
        labels =. /:~~.present

            fields =. fields,<(>label),' ',integer +/label=present
        end.
        lines =. lines,<(column{::columns),': ',(integer #present),' values, ',(integer (#source)-#present),' missing, ',(integer #labels),' levels: ',', 'join fields
    end.
    lines =. lines,(<''),<'Correlations (pairwise complete observations):'
    rows =. 0$a:
    for_a. numeric do.
        fields =. a{columns
        for_b. numeric do.
            a_cells =. a{"1 source
            b_cells =. b{"1 source
            mask =. (a_cells~:< 'NA')*.b_cells~:< 'NA'
            xs =. decimal&>mask#a_cells
            ys =. decimal&>mask#b_cells
            mean_x =. (ordered_sum xs)%#xs
            mean_y =. (ordered_sum ys)%#ys
            cross =. 0.0
            square_x =. 0.0
            square_y =. 0.0
            for_index. i.#xs do.
                x =. (index{xs)-mean_x
                z =. (index{ys)-mean_y
                cross =. cross+x*z
                square_x =. square_x+x*x
                square_y =. square_y+z*z
            end.
            fields =. fields,<four cross%%:square_x*square_y
        end.
        rows =. rows,<fields
    end.
    header =. (<'column'),numeric{columns
    lines,(table_plain (<header),<rows),<''
)
information_criteria =: 3 : 0

        lines =. lines,<'Step ',(integer step),': ',(model format_model terms),' (RSS ',(four f_rss fitted),', df ',(integer degrees),', AIC ',(four 1{criteria),')'
        if. 0=#terms do.
            lines =. lines,<'  stop: no removable terms'
            break.
        end.
        results =. marginal_tests (<design),(<fitted),(<terms),<0{params
        largest =. 0{::results
        for_box. results do.
            result =. >box
            lines =. lines,<'  - ',(t_name result),': F ',(four t_f result),' on ',(integer t_df result),' and ',(integer degrees),' DF, p-value ',probability t_probability result
            if. (t_probability result)>t_probability largest do.
                largest =. result
            end.
        end.
        if. (t_probability largest)<:alpha do.
            lines =. lines,<'  stop: largest p-value ',(probability t_probability largest),' is not above ',four alpha
            break.
        end.
        lines =. lines,<'  remove ',t_name largest
        terms =. terms-.t_index largest
        fitted =. fit_subset (<design),(<terms),<0{params
        step =. step+1
    end.
    lines,<'Final model: ',model format_model terms
)
forward_selection =: 3 : 0
    'report params' =. y
    design =. b_design report
    model =. d_model design
    terms =. i.0
    lines =. <'Forward selection by AIC (model 1, rows ',(integer #d_rows design),')'
    step =. 1
    while. 1 do.
        fitted =. fit_subset (<design),(<terms),<0{params
        criteria =. information_criteria fitted
        lines =. lines,<'Step ',(integer step),': ',(model format_model terms),' (AIC ',(four 1{criteria),')'
        available =. (model_terms model)candidates terms
        if. 0=#available do.
            lines =. lines,<'  stop: no candidate terms remain'
            break.
        end.
        best_index =. _1
        best_aic =. 0.0
        best_terms =. i.0
        for_index. available do.
            candidate_terms =. /:~terms,index
            candidate =. fit_subset (<design),(<candidate_terms),<0{params
            candidate_aic =. 1{information_criteria candidate
            lines =. lines,<'  + ',(t_name index{::model_terms model),': AIC ',four candidate_aic
            if. (best_index<0)+.candidate_aic<best_aic do.
                best_index =. index
                best_aic =. candidate_aic
                best_terms =. candidate_terms
            end.
        end.
        if. best_aic>:1{criteria do.
            lines =. lines,<'  stop: no candidate lowers the AIC'
            break.
        end.
        lines =. lines,<'  add ',t_name best_index{::model_terms model
        terms =. best_terms
        step =. step+1
    end.
    lines,<'Final model: ',model format_model terms
)

qr_fit =: 3 : 0
    'matrix response weights tolerance' =. y
    n =. #matrix
    p =. 1{$matrix
    roots =. %:weights
    weighted =. matrix
    for_i. i.n do.
        weighted =. ((i{matrix)*i{roots)i}weighted
    end.
    work =. weighted
    transformed =. roots*response
    lengths =. p$0.0
    for_j. i.p do.
        column =. j{"1 weighted
        lengths =. (%:ordered_sum column*column)j}lengths
    end.
    triangular =. (p,p)$0.0
    accepted =. i.0
    aliases =. i.0
    for_j. i.p do.
        k =. #accepted
        column =. k}.j{"1 work
        eta =. %:ordered_sum column*column
        if. eta<:tolerance*j{lengths do.
            aliases =. aliases,j
            continue.
        end.
        accepted =. accepted,j
        if. ((<k,j){work)>:0 do.
            alpha =. -eta
        else.
            alpha =. eta
        end.
        vector =. k}.j{"1 work
        vector =. ((0{vector)-alpha)0}vector
        squared =. ordered_sum vector*vector
        for_l. i.k do.
            triangular =. ((<l,j){work)(<l,k)}triangular
        end.
        triangular =. alpha (<k,k)}triangular
        for_l. (j+1)+i.p-j+1 do.
            dot =. ordered_sum vector*k}.l{"1 work
            delta =. (2.0*dot)%squared
            for_i. k+i.n-k do.
                work =. (((<i,l){work)-delta*(i-k){vector)(<i,l)}work
            end.
        end.
        dot =. ordered_sum vector*k}.transformed
        delta =. (2.0*dot)%squared
        for_i. k+i.n-k do.
            transformed =. ((i{transformed)-delta*(i-k){vector)i}transformed
        end.
    end.
    rank =. #accepted
    effects =. rank{.transformed
    beta =. p$0.0
    triangular =. (rank,rank){.triangular
    for_k. |.i.rank do.
        tail =. 0.0
        for_l. (k+1)+i.rank-k+1 do.
            tail =. tail+((<k,l){triangular)*(l{accepted){beta
        end.
        beta =. (((k{effects)-tail)%(<k,k){triangular)(k{accepted)}beta
    end.
    inverse =. (rank,rank)$0.0
    for_m. i.rank do.
        for_l. |.i.rank do.
            tail =. 0.0
            for_q. (l+1)+i.rank-l+1 do.
                tail =. tail+((<l,q){triangular)*(<q,m){inverse
            end.
            value =. ((0.0+l=m)-tail)%(<l,l){triangular
            inverse =. value (<l,m)}inverse
        end.
    end.
    variance =. rank$0.0
    for_k. i.rank do.
        row =. k{inverse
        variance =. (ordered_sum row*row)k}variance
    end.
    u =. (n,rank)$0.0
    g =. (n,rank)$0.0
    leverage =. n$0.0
    fitted =. n$0.0
    residual =. n$0.0
    weighted_residual =. n$0.0
    rss =. 0.0
    for_i. i.n do.
        h =. 0.0
        for_k. i.rank do.
            sum =. 0.0
            for_m. i.rank do.
                sum =. sum+((<i,(m{accepted)){weighted)*(<m,k){inverse
            end.
            u =. sum (<i,k)}u
            h =. h+sum*sum
        end.
        leverage =. h i}leverage
        for_k. i.rank do.
            sum =. 0.0
            for_m. i.rank do.
                sum =. sum+((<k,m){inverse)*(<i,m){u
            end.
            g =. sum (<i,k)}g
        end.
        value =. 0.0
        for_k. i.rank do.
            value =. value+((<i,(k{accepted)){matrix)*(k{accepted){beta
        end.
        fitted =. value i}fitted
        difference =. (i{response)-value
        residual =. difference i}residual
        weighted_difference =. (i{roots)*difference
        weighted_residual =. weighted_difference i}weighted_residual
        rss =. rss+weighted_difference*weighted_difference
    end.
    (<matrix),(<response),(<weights),(<n),(<p),(<rank),(<accepted),(<aliases),(<triangular),(<effects),(<beta),(<inverse),(<variance),(<u),(<g),(<leverage),(<fitted),(<residual),(<weighted_residual),<rss
)
